message: In our rush to stay connected, it’s easy to overlook the simple joys of being prepared. Rediscovering low-tech fun can be a delightful way to bond with our families while ensuring we have what we need during any unexpected moments. A well-thought-out kit can spark creativity and even lead to some memorable family activities as we put it together. Let’s embrace the chance to enjoy the process together and remember: preparedness doesn’t have to be complicated! What fun items would you include in your family kit? 😊
